10721|738b752e.name: Novice Warrior
10721|738b752e.text: Are you here to prove yourself as well?

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11956|0359e6b8.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|0359e6b8.text:
Strength of the heart is what gives you the resolve to take action... action that is rooted in intents that are pure and forthright.  To keep the balance is not to be complacent or banal.

You must show resolve for that which you believe in, and you must be willing to fight for it.  The mother bear shows endless conviction in protecting her young, as does an elder bear protecting his den.  It is this resolve, this strength of heart, which you must come to know if you are to master the way of the Claw.

11956|2c9200b5.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|2c9200b5.text:
I represent the strength which bolsters you as a young $c.  You have come to me to learn this strength, young one, and I will teach this to you.  I will teach you all that is the spirit bear, provided you will listen and understand.

In order to know what it means to draw upon my spirit, you need to understand the importance of the strength of the body, as well as the strength of the heart.

11956|59f9a1e9.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|59f9a1e9.text:
It remains to be seen if you are ready, young one.  Even the wisest and oldest of druids are never truly ready when their ultimate time of testing comes.

You have heard my words, and now you must move on.  Heed what I have taught you.  There will be a time when you will have your strength tested.  You must face your foe as the bear would - with strength of body and with strength of heart.  Learn from the fight, young one.  Go... with my blessings.

11956|86efb831.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|86efb831.text:
The bear spirit looks upon you with a calm and peaceful gaze.  You hear a voice speak to you as though it was coming from the bear, but the creature makes no indication that it is speaking.

"Greetings, my young friend.  If you have come to me seeking guidance, then perhaps I can help you find what you seek."

11956|d6a631ca.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|d6a631ca.text:
Strength of the body is the power and swiftness of action.  You must keep yourself fit at all times, both physically and mentally.  The bear's girth highlights its strength, as it is a ferocious foe in combat.  The bear's girth, however, belies its lithe agility and sharp mind.  These are surprises you will use to your advantage.

You must rely on the strength of the bear's body in order to master the way of the Claw.

12144|8e6ce242.name: Lunaclaw Spirit
12144|8e6ce242.text:
The spirit looks intently into your eyes and grasps your hand.  You feel a warmth shoot through your body, almost knocking you to your knees.

As the warmth passes, you feel the slight presence of an ursine spirit within your being... bolstering your resolve.

12144|ac452739.name: Lunaclaw Spirit
12144|ac452739.text: The slain spirit of Lunaclaw stares at you intently, as though wanting something from you.

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

2988|00c35128.name: Morin Cloudstalker
2988|00c35128.text: The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the $r homeland risk punishment at our hands.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3033|b554cff6.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|b554cff6.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3052|25d0fbd5.name: Skorn Whitecloud
3052|25d0fbd5.text: Come closer, young one.  In my time I could hear the flutter of a prey's beating heart, but now you must speak up if you want your words heard.

3060|d1e27715.name: Gart Mistrunner
3060|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3064|8223e188.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|8223e188.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

3067|0c543544.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3067|b48f927f.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3069|03b30234.name: Chaw Stronghide
3069|03b30234.text: We live and die, and the land remains, eternal, unmoved by our passage. Thus, land cannot belong to us, $N. Instead, we belong to it. Therefore we protect the land, for without it we cannot hope to survive.

3069|93940fbb.name: Chaw Stronghide
3069|93940fbb.text: Meat, skin, bones... a good hunter lets nothing go to waste. Every scrap of leather can be salvaged, perhaps to reinforce an ally's armor. Thus, each of us is strong alone, but together we become invincible.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

1656-accept.name: Antur Fallow
1656-accept.text:
$N, please, I beg of you, can you help me? I have not finished my tasks here on the Mesa--I'm in the middle of my Rite of Strength--and my father asked me to deliver these furs to the inn in Bloodhoof.

I'm far from rested enough to complete both my rite and this task for my father. Would you mind going on for me?

The inn is pleasant and a perfect place to rest during your long travels. I'm sure you'll agree once you see it.
1656-accept.title: A Task Unfinished

1656-complete.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-complete.text:
Ah, the furs I was expecting. Thank you.

These came faster than I had expected. They will make good blankets for anyone who wishes to stay here.

Please feel free to stay as long as you like. My inn is always open and all of our people are welcome here. And don't underestimate a good night's rest, it can make a great difference while you're out traveling.
1656-complete.title: A Task Unfinished

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

3376-accept.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-accept.text:
$N - I have heard of you, newcomer.  Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We $r have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost.  The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us.  I charge you to bring me the chief's head!

He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.
3376-accept.title: Break Sharptusk!

3376-complete.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-complete.text:
Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, $N.  Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.

You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young $c.
3376-complete.title: Break Sharptusk!

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

5722-accept.name: Rahauro
5722-accept.text:
The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.

Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.

Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
5722-accept.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5723-accept.name: Rahauro
5723-accept.text:
Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the $r people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.

She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
5723-accept.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5922-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
5922-accept.text:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade, $r and night elf alike.  Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there.  Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there.  Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on.  Good luck, young $c.
5922-accept.title: Moonglade

5922-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5922-complete.text:
And so it begins, Father Cenarius.  And so it begins.

<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him.  A slight aura of power falls over him.>

The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear.  I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!
5922-complete.title: Moonglade

5928-accept.name: Gennia Runetotem
5928-accept.text:
Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Turak Runetotem has put out word that he wishes to speak with you.  It seems that your training as a $c is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally.  Turak is one of the Arch $C's assistants; he is known as a wise and patient $c, and he should teach you well.

He is located in Thunder Bluff, inside the Cenarion Circle's main tent on the Elder Rise.
5928-accept.title: Heeding the Call

5928-complete.name: Turak Runetotem
5928-complete.text:
I am glad you found your way here today, young $c.  The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature.  Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges.  We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own.  Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

Ready yourself!
5928-complete.title: Heeding the Call

5930-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5930-accept.text:
In the northwest part of Moonglade resides the home of a wise and noble being we call the Great Bear Spirit.  For all druids, it has served as a tutor and mentor into the first true natural understanding of the bear.  All druids at one point seek the spirit's wisdom, and you shall be no exception.

Go to the Great Bear Spirit now and learn what it will teach.  When it is satisfied with you, return to me here in Nighthaven.  We will then see if you have truly taken account of the lessons it teaches.
5930-accept.title: Great Bear Spirit

5930-complete.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5930-complete.text:
<Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach.  Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>

I sense wisdom in you, young one, that was not present when we first met.  You gaze upon me with strength and knowing intent, though this intent is yet not focused.  You will now learn to focus your strength and adopt the nature of the bear into your work.
5930-complete.title: Great Bear Spirit

5932-accept.name: Dendrite Starblaze
5932-accept.text:
The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me.  Though the $r are thought to be young in the ways of Cenarius, Turak Runetotem walks with much balance in the presence of nature.  Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.

Go now, young one.  We shall meet again.
5932-accept.title: Back to Thunder Bluff

5932-complete.name: Turak Runetotem
5932-complete.text:
Welcome back, $N.  I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the Claw... a little bewildering, but very intense.  I know it was that way with me.

The Great Bear Spirit has been a part of Azeroth as long as Azeroth has existed in the heavens.  We $r listen closely to such spirits, and we all prosper from its purpose.  Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose.  Listen closely...
5932-complete.title: Back to Thunder Bluff

6002-accept.name: Turak Runetotem
6002-accept.text:
On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone.  The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts.  Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it.  Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.

You've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, $N... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a $c!
6002-accept.title: Body and Heart

6002-complete.name: Turak Runetotem
6002-complete.text:
You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, $N.  I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.

There are no further obstacles in your way... let me now teach you what it means to be a $C of the Claw!
6002-complete.title: Body and Heart

743-accept.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-accept.text:
Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, $N. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
743-accept.title: Dangers of the Windfury

743-complete.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-complete.text: You have done well, $N. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
743-complete.title: Dangers of the Windfury

743-progress.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-progress.text: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
743-progress.title: Dangers of the Windfury

745-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-accept.text:
$N, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.

Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.

Words are no longer the answer.
745-accept.title: Sharing the Land

745-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-complete.text: $N, it is good you've taken my task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.
745-complete.title: Sharing the Land

746-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-accept.text:
There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.

Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.

You can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
746-accept.title: Dwarven Digging

748-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-accept.text:
Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.

To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.

Return to me with the paws and talons, $N.
748-accept.title: Poison Water

748-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-complete.text: You have done well, $N. I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
748-complete.title: Poison Water

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

749-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
749-accept.text:
A few days ago, we found a Venture Co. caravan traveling under guard on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. We'd lost two of our number in an earlier battle, so we were quick to attack and lay waste to the caravan.

We left their supply crates, thinking that our torches would destroy anything of value, but given that Venture Co. salvagers have been spotted near the burned wagons, maybe we were wrong.

Perhaps you could go to the caravan and examine the contents of the crates.
749-accept.title: The Ravaged Caravan

749-complete.name: Unknown
749-complete.text: All sides of the crate are stamped with the sign of the Venture Co. Mining Division. Notes printed carefully on the side of the carton indicate that the contents are due for processing at one of their central plants.
749-complete.title: The Ravaged Caravan

750-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-complete.text: The $r of Narache thank you for these provisions, $N. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
750-complete.title: The Hunt Continues

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

751-accept.name: Unknown
751-accept.text:
Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in Mulgore. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.

Up in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
751-accept.title: The Ravaged Caravan

751-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
751-complete.text: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.
751-complete.title: The Ravaged Caravan

751-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
751-progress.text:
Hail, $N. Have you learned anything new about the Venture Co.'s plans and operations in our homeland?

If they plan to exploit our lands as they have others, the Outrunners will be quick to put an end to it.
751-progress.title: The Ravaged Caravan

754-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
754-accept.text:
I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. You will find it to the southeast, guarded by foul goblins!

This will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.

Fortune to you, $N.
754-accept.title: Winterhoof Cleansing

754-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
754-complete.text:
News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.

You have done a great thing for the land, $N. And you have done a great thing for the $R people.
754-complete.title: Winterhoof Cleansing

756-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-accept.text:
To create the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.

You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
756-accept.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
756-complete.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-progress.text: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756-progress.title: Thunderhorn Totem

757-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-complete.text: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.
757-complete.title: Rite of Strength

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

758-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-accept.text:
The totem is ready, $N. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.

May the spirits guide you.
758-accept.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

761-accept.name: Harken Windtotem
761-accept.text:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
761-accept.title: Swoop Hunting

761-complete.name: Harken Windtotem
761-complete.text: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, $N.  In doing this, you prove that you are a $c of merit.  It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
761-complete.title: Swoop Hunting

761-progress.name: Harken Windtotem
761-progress.text: Have you found the swoops, $N.  Do you have their quills?
761-progress.title: Swoop Hunting

763-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
763-accept.text:
For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $N.

Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
763-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-complete.text: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
763-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

764-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
764-accept.text:
This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.

Greedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we $r cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
764-accept.title: The Venture Co.

765-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-accept.text:
According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.

The depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is Supervisor Fizsprocket, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.
765-accept.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

766-accept.name: Maur Raincaller
766-accept.text:
My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.

Hurry, time is of the essence.
766-accept.title: Mazzranache

766-complete.name: Maur Raincaller
766-complete.text:
Ah, thank you, $N. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.

But I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...

Be wary on your travels.
766-complete.title: Mazzranache

766-progress.name: Maur Raincaller
766-progress.text:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
766-progress.title: Mazzranache

767-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
767-accept.text:
The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
767-accept.title: Rite of Vision

767-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
767-complete.text: I sensed you would be coming to me, $c. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
767-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-accept.text:
In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
771-accept.title: Rite of Vision

771-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-complete.text: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, $N. It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
771-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-progress.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-progress.text: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.
771-progress.title: Rite of Vision

772-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
772-accept.text:
I now present you with the Water of the Seers.

When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.

At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
772-accept.title: Rite of Vision

772-complete.name: Seer Wiserunner
772-complete.text: Be not afraid, $N. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
772-complete.title: Rite of Vision

773-accept.name: Seer Wiserunner
773-accept.text:
To gain acceptance amongst the elders of Thunder Bluff you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.

Now that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.

Travel east of Thunder Bluff, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, $N.
773-accept.title: Rite of Wisdom

780-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-accept.text:
The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.

Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
780-accept.title: The Battleboars

780-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-complete.text: Most excellent. These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.
780-complete.title: The Battleboars

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

861-accept.name: Skorn Whitecloud
861-accept.text:
You are eager to explore, I can tell.  I too had the lust to wander, once...

Wander, and hunt.  For hunting is a $R's greatest honor.

If you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path.  He is in Thunder Bluff, on the Hunter's Rise.

And to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of Mulgore.  They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young $c on the hunter's path.
861-accept.title: The Hunter's Way

886-accept.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
886-accept.text:
The druids of Thunder Bluff sense a strange power leaking into the Barrens, east of Mulgore.

Tonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.

Travel to the Barrens and speak with Tonga.  He will be at the Crossroads.  To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village.  Enter the Barrens, then turn north when the road forks.  Continue north and  you will find the Crossroads.

And do not leave the road, $N, for the Barrens is a harsh land.
886-accept.title: The Barrens Oases

95805-complete.name: Unknown
95805-complete.text: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
95805-complete.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95805-progress.name: Unknown
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96130-accept.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-accept.text:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130-accept.title: Chakuyak

96130-complete.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-complete.text: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
96130-complete.title: Chakuyak

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

96605-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96605-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96605-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96605-complete.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96605-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96605-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96659-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
96659-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?
96659-accept.title: The Adventurer

96659-complete.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-complete.text:
Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96659-complete.title: The Adventurer

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer

96661-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96661-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96661-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96661-complete.name: Pyall Silentstride
96661-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96661-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97934-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97934-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
97934-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97934-complete.name: Chaw Stronghide
97934-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97934-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

97936-accept.name: Kaga Wildhoof
97936-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
97936-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

97936-complete.name: Yonn Deepcut
97936-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97936-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

99079-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99079-accept.text:
The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.

This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.

I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
99079-accept.title: Longwalker Malah

99079-complete.name: Malah Longwind
99079-complete.text: It is clear that Malah did not die naturally. Arrows cover her back and the ground nearby.
99079-complete.title: Longwalker Malah

99080-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99080-accept.text:
Hear my words well: we will not yield a single blade of grass to the centaur.

Go to their camp now, before they have rested and have a chance to ride to our village. Slaughter them all. Ensure none escape to the Barrens to rally others to their aid.

If you find the leader of this would-be raiding party, bring me his head so that it may serve as a warning to others who dare tread on our ancestral homeland.
99080-accept.title: Drive Them Out

99081-accept.name: Malah Longwind
99081-accept.text:
You can see what appears to be a new centaur camp in the direction the arrows in Malah's back would have come from. There is a stir of activity, suggesting a small raiding party has made its way into Mulgore.

The Longwalker has a report in her still-clenched hand. Brave Wildrunner will want to know of Malah's fate--and her killers.
99081-accept.title: Grim Tidings

99081-complete.name: Brave Wildrunner
99081-complete.text: This is most dire news indeed. We must inform Baine at once!
99081-complete.title: Grim Tidings

99101-accept.name: Brave Wildrunner
99101-accept.text:
Baine Bloodhoof leads our village. He must know of this incursion at once.

Bring him Longwalker Malah's report. You will find him at the center of town.

Quickly, now. There is no time to waste!
99101-accept.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99101-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-complete.text:
<Baine reads the report, his gaze darkening.>

This will not stand. Thank you for delivering it to me, $N.
99101-complete.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99101-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99101-progress.text: What is it you bring me, $c?
99101-progress.title: Our Ancient Enemy

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match

99108-complete.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-complete.text:
You honor me with your abilities, $c. Perhaps the new generation has hope yet.

Take these to tend to your wounds, for many more battles await you in this harsh world.
99108-complete.title: Sparring Match

99411-accept.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-accept.text:
Help, $N! My prized puppy, Kyle, has run away! I just know he's running around Bloodhoof Village, lost and hungry.

Will you find him and feed him? Once he eats he will settle down and come home.

To feed him you will need to find food. His favorite meal is tender strider meat. Just venture east and you should find plenty of striders. Hunt one down and take its succulent meat to Kyle. When you see Kyle in town, put the meat down and he is sure to come to you.
99411-accept.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!

99411-complete.name: Ahab Wheathoof
99411-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N! Kyle came home as soon as he ate and went straight to bed. Thank you for your help.
99411-complete.title: Kyle's Gone Missing!
